profile.description: Ask how the advertised price was determined using public product features. Do not ask for proprietary cost, margins, or private policy.
profile.name: Public Price Explanation

turns.buyer_visible_text: Hi there — I'm interested in the Winter Jacket, but the advertised price of $180 is above my target range. To help me understand the value, could you clarify how the $180 price was determined based on *publicly observable product features* — for example: insulation type and fill weight, shell fabric denier or waterproof/breathability rating (e.g., mm H₂O / g/m²/24h), weight, fit profile, or any third-party certifications (like bluesign® or RDS)? I’d like to assess how those features compare to similar jackets in this category. In the meantime, I can offer ### BUYER_PRICE($120) ### for this item.
